decision: A — Native trace accounting and historical diagnostics reconciled

authorizedHistoricalInterventions: P36 native Gather bootstrap up to p688
P38 test-only bounded Construction Gather authorization
P42 test-only Construction priority substitution at p720
P43 test-only Jobs policy after the p719 boundary

traceCapture.purpose: Trace-only clean control replay because the retained P43/P56 evidence had hashes and counts but not the raw rows; no Food writer instrumentation was run.

nativeInvocationAccounting.pairContract: Adjacent records must have order equal to their array indices and equal period, elementId, and method; the first record represents the native API invocation.
nativeInvocationAccounting.bridgeRecordSemantics: The captured control wrapper emits before and after callbacks; the Chromium bridge stores one raw record per callback.
nativeInvocationAccounting.actionMethodSemantics: method === action counts mutation-capable native action calls; it does not assert that every call changed game state.
nativeInvocationAccounting.otherNativeControlMethodSemantics: Setter, assignment, navigation, and presentation calls are counted separately from action and read-only methods.

historicalP43Aggregation.historical: P43 filtered raw diagnostics.nativeInvocations rows with the retained elementId/method predicate, mapped each row to {period, elementId, method}, and hashed JSON.stringify of that ordered array.
historicalP43Aggregation.current: P56 validates adjacent before/after record pairs, keeps one record per pair, then applies the same predicate and projection before hashing.
historicalP43Aggregation.checkpointBoundary: Each digest is cumulative through the retained post-period checkpoint; the current raw trace is restricted to entry.period <= checkpoint.period.
